newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps downgrades CAI Wireless.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps downgrades CAI Wireless.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it lowered the rating of CAI Wireless Inc's senior notes to Single B from Double B Minus.
It said the notes will remain on rating watch-down.

Duff & Phelps said the new rating takes into account the impact of current implementation delays and increased uncertainty regarding the complete implementation of a business relationship amendment with Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp.

On Friday, Bell Atlantic Corp and its merger partner NYNEX said they were re-evaluating their methods for offering video to homes. Bell Atlantic had cited disappointing results from strategic partner CAI Wireless as a reason for the review.
